row: If you love dogs and want to support animal rescue, then welcome to our YouTube home. We are Foster Tales Rescue, a 501c3 nonprofit dog rescue in Bakersfield California. We save dogs from over-crowded animal shelters where they are at risk of euthanasia. Follow our True Rescue Stories series to get the whole story from a shelter dog's freedom moment, to their veterinary care if needed and then life with their foster family and hopefully their adoption to their forever home. Our stories are original, when you support this channel you are supporting true animal lovers who are working to save dogs every day. We actually place homeless dogs in their forever homes! Join us for every episode True Rescue Stories for heartwarming tales about these beautiful and resiliant dogs. Your views, likes, and shares help us save more dogs and keep us making new episodes.
